recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-35940 unless a future work group decision changes the Questionnaire presentation guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-35940 was a Published FHIR-I Change Request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking the Questionnaire Scope and Usage section to state that Questionnaires can define standardized presentation/rendering of data that already exists, not only capture new data.
initial_application: The Jira comments first pointed to PR #1741 and then corrected the implementation link to PR #1840. Git commit 4b3c7200ba inserted the requested paragraph into source/questionnaire/questionnaire-introduction.xml, and merge commit 0a504b4679 brought PR #1840 into the main history. Current blame still attributes the paragraph to 4b3c7200ba.
additional_context: The Questionnaire resource is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/questionnaire/questionnaire-introduction.xml is in current build scope. The 2022-03-03 FHIR SDC minutes list FHIR-35940 as Persuasive, matching the Jira vote record. Searches for Zulip discussion and adjacent Jira text found no conflicting later decision; FHIR-35941 appeared only as a neighboring Questionnaire tracker with separate boundaries-and-relationships scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current Questionnaire Scope and Usage source already contains the requested standardized presentation paragraph, including examples for peri-natal and diabetes management forms, editable or read-only presentation, and non-persisted QuestionnaireResponses.
